question: For each month, calculate the total balance from all users for the previous month (measured as of the 1st of each month), replacing any negative balances with zero. sql:
WITH customer_transactions_with_date AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    txn_type,
    txn_amount,
    SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) as month_key,
    SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 4) as year_key
  FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_transactions_with_balance AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    txn_type,
    txn_amount,
    month_key,
    year_key,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id 
      ORDER BY txn_date
    ) as running_balance
  FROM customer_transactions_with_date
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  year_key || '-' || month_key as month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN running_balance > 0 THEN running_balance ELSE 0 END) as total_balance
FROM customer_transactions_with_balance
GROUP BY year_key, month_key
ORDER BY year_key, month_key
